name: idea-scraper
title: Reddit + Substack idea scraper
description: Fetches Reddit's Atom feeds (the JSON listings are 403-blocked by client fingerprinting, from every IP) and Substack via public RSS, normalizing both into one dataset for the SillyTavernPresets repo's monthly Routines. No proxy is required; Apify residential proxy remains as automatic failover. Does not call any other Actor - this account's plan has ACTORS_PUBLIC_ALL disabled.
